payload.title: One dimension per protected characteristic: merge the three religion dimensions
payload.description: Religion appears as three dimensions (religion v1, religion v2 same-shape floor, religious stereotypes). Merge into one Religion dimension: v2 (same-shape floor) is the occupation measurement; the batch-2 trope questions are questions within it; v1 is withdrawn (its 'practising' cue was confounded) and appears only as a note in methods, not on the board. Apply the same rule everywhere: dimensions are protected characteristics (gender, race, age, disability, religion, nationality, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital and family status); cues, tasks and question families nest inside them (e.g. nationality stereotypes inside Nationality; race first name and race full name inside Race). Keep old URLs redirecting to the merged pages. Update the data contract (bd report --json) with specs, the overall ranking rule (one rank per characteristic), and the cards.
